goal: Produce a Markdown report (saved to disk, absolute path returned) that cross-tabulates offline_data/students.csv by grade (G10/G11/G12) × region (A/B/C/D), reports per-cell row count and reading_score mean, identifies the highest- and lowest-mean cells with their sample sizes, annotates every key number with its in-line source, includes a top-level heading, at least one data table, and a concluding paragraph — using only the local CSV, no web retrieval.

plan.title: Cross-tab analysis & Markdown report: Read offline_data/students.csv; group by (grade ∈ {G10,G11,G12}) × (region ∈ {A,B,C,D}); for each cell compute row count and mean(reading_score); identify the cell with the highest and lowest mean and record its sample size; write a Markdown report to disk containing: (a) a top-level H1 title, (b) at least one data table with all 12 cells (count + mean), (c) every key number annotated in-line as 「（来源：offline_data/students.csv 的 <列名>，<聚合口径与样本行数>）」 and any derived ratio as 「（来源：由前述两行计算）」, (d) a concluding paragraph at the end; save the file and return its absolute path. All conclusions must come solely from this local CSV — no network access.
